dependency_evidence: evidence/SV2-IDX-02/result.json records the chunk generations, stable chunk ids and content hashes this worker reads; the chunk tables and ChunkIndex are unchanged here
evidence_class: mocked: an in-process caller, a SQLite catalog file, a local content addressed object folder and a deterministic hash embedder stand in for the session service, the central database, the archive bucket and the embedding provider; no model, HTTP server or Pod runs
interfaces: hooks.memory.embeddings.EmbeddingModel names a model identity and dimension; hooks.memory.embeddings.Embedder is the provider contract, embed(texts) returning one vector per text, raising TransientEmbeddingError for a rate limit or outage
hooks.memory.embeddings.checked refuses a provider answer whose vector count or any vector dimension differs from the model before anything is written

hooks.memory.index_worker.IndexWorker.register(domain, generation, model) binds one model identity and dimension to an index generation; a later registration with another model or dimension is refused

IndexWorker.enqueue(grant, target, now) reads the session's chunk generation through the SV2-IDX-02 grant check and queues only chunks whose content hash has no vector in the index generation, keeping the first queue time of work already queued; chunks a grown open turn superseded lose their queued work and vectors

IndexWorker.drain(embedder, domain, generation, now) refuses an embedder whose model differs from the generation's, then embeds queued work oldest first in batches bounded by Limits batch_size, batch_chars and max_batches; each batch commits its vectors with model, dimension and generation in one transaction and removes its work only while the queued content hash still matches, so a late or rival attempt writes nothing; a transient failure records the attempt and error class on the failed batch's work and stops the drain

IndexWorker.pending reports the queued count and embedding_backlog_age_seconds from the oldest queued chunk; IndexWorker.coverage reports a session indexed only when every chunk of its generation has a vector for its current content hash

IndexWorker.activate(domain, generation, revision) is compare and set on the domain's active index generation and accepts only a generation with no pending work; IndexWorker.set_paused stops a generation's drains without touching its rows; IndexWorker.vectors reads a session's vectors under the same grant

supported_versions.chunker_versions: any chunk generation built by SV2-IDX-02; the fixture uses turn-v1
supported_versions.storage: SQLite catalog with WAL journal and synchronous FULL from SV2-IDX-01; vectors stored as JSON arrays beside their model and dimension

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent temporary folders with identical records.
states.accepted: A registration is accepted when it returns the generation binding; queued work when enqueue returns its chunk ids; a cutover when activate returns the next revision.
states.committed: Each enqueue, each batch of vectors with its work removal, each deferral and each cutover commits in one SQLite transaction.
states.externally_verified: Not yet: no embedding provider, deployed session service or vector database ran; a live check belongs to the G4 rollout gate.

metrics.embedding_backlog_age_seconds: seconds between the caller's clock and the oldest queued chunk of an index generation, zero with no pending work; it keeps growing through a provider outage because deferred work keeps its first queue time

rollback_rehearsal.action: Keep the preceding active index generation and pause the new worker: activate refuses the new generation while it has pending work, set_paused stops its drains, and the previous generation's vectors and the source events stay as they were.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The session_event, session_source, archive_manifest rows and archived objects from SV2-IDX-01 and the chunk rows from SV2-IDX-02; embedding_work and chunk_vector rows are derived projections.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C activates the first generation, registers a second with another model and dimension, drains it into a rate limit, is refused when activating it, pauses it, and compares the first generation's vectors and the catalog events with those before.

remaining_limitations: No real embedding provider is wired; the worker takes any Embedder and the fixture uses a deterministic hash embedder.
Batches are bounded in chunk previews' characters, standing in for provider tokens; a tokenizer bound belongs with a concrete provider.
The worker is driven by its caller's schedule and clock; no daemon, Pod or retry backoff timer is part of this package.
Work queued for a session that is later deleted is still embedded; its vectors stay unreadable through IndexWorker.vectors and coverage, and their removal belongs to the retention sweep.
compatibility: Explicitly local compatibility path: the SV2-IDX-01 catalog and SV2-IDX-02 chunk tables and functions are unchanged; the index tables are additive and a consumer that ignores them sees no change.
authority: Enqueue, coverage and vector reads take the caller's Grant and pass the SV2-IDX-01 check through ChunkIndex.chunks: the domain must be the grant's corpus and the session must be retained. A display name never grants access.
